dedupe_keys.name: grid agnostic mhd for extended research applications helio

description: GAMERA-Helio simulates the three-dimensional solar wind with magnetohydrodynamics and gravity. WSA coronal maps provide boundary conditions, and the computational radial extent can be configured. The resource is documented by JHU/APL; JHU APL. The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The default radial limits are model settings, not universal geographic coverage. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
